summary.result: The results of the variance analysis (ANOVA) showed that the p-value of the power and pretreatment temperature among the independent variables were significant (p<0.05), and in particular, the pretreatment temperature significantly affected on the solubilization and methane production.
summary.background: The objective of this study was to find an optimum methane yield condition in anaerobic digestion of sewage sludge with microwave pretreatment.
